answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can earn: the stake returns only after a long window of honest service, and proven fraud slashes it. A new identity starts as an isolated island with no trust, so a Sybil attacker must fund each copy separately and the cost grows with every fake. The delta between that stake cost and the small reward one fake can earn makes mass forgery unprofitable, while honest agents get their bond back and keep working.
